headline: Reserve Bank of India Plans App-Based Access to Sovereign Bond Market for Retail Traders
summary: The Reserve Bank of India is planning to allow broker applications to facilitate retail investment in the country's $2.3 trillion sovereign debt market.
why: Expanding retail access to Indian government bonds aims to deepen domestic liquidity and diversify sovereign debt holders beyond institutional banks.
